thought_process.skill_suggestions: Add an alert system for low-inventory stations or a predictive demand chart showing forecasted bike needs based on weather data.
assumed_from_scratch: Interactive state management for global filters (Date Range, User Type)
Search and sort logic for the Station Inventory Table
Interactive Detail Modal for individual stations
Full Light/Dark mode implementation using exact arbitrary hex tokens
thought_process.interpretation: An operational and executive dashboard for tracking bike rentals. It targets a Business Analyst or Operations Manager persona, focusing on high-level KPIs (rentals, active rides, revenue, durations), temporal trends, user composition, and real-time station inventory. It includes fully functional filtering (date range, membership type), search/sorting on station status, and a detailed station modal.
